name: white-lights-web
description: Test harness for the pure logic and pages under web/. Ships nothing to the browser — the app itself stays framework-free, no build step; this is dev-only tooling. Two layers: `npm test` (Vitest) unit-tests the pure logic in web/lib/*.mjs; `npm run test:e2e` (Playwright) drives the actual pages in a real browser, which is the only way to exercise <script type="module"> at all — jsdom does not execute module scripts.
